Return a list of output lines, rather than printing them. Preserve leading spaces and use no trailing spaces. n >= 0. Use diamond row sizes 1..n then n-1..1. A size-1 row has one star; other rows have two stars separated by 2*i-3 spaces. Prefix each row with n-i spaces.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    3
  ],
  "expected": [
    "  *",
    " * *",
    "*   *",
    " * *",
    "  *"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    0
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Only the first and last star of each row survive.

Complexity: O(n^2) characters of time and output
